title: Bugs found while recording the video catalogue
why: The 2026-10-21 recording run hit these on camera and worked around them. A client demo film (Skanda Travels) is recorded next and must not need workarounds.

items.bug: Team report (/reports/team) answers 403 for the sales_manager role
items.cause: The route or report definition requires role 'manager'; the real role id is 'sales_manager'.
items.fix: Use the real role ids from backend/src/constants/permissions.ts. Grep the backend and desktop for any other check against 'manager' that should be 'sales_manager' and fix those too.
items.test: Backend test: sales_manager gets 200 on the team report, salesperson keeps its current answer.

items.bug: Inbox list does not update when a new message arrives; the notification bell does
items.fix: Make the inbox list (and an open thread) refresh on the same realtime event the bell uses, or invalidate the inbox query when that event arrives.
items.test: e2e: with the inbox open, POST /test/inbound a WhatsApp message; the new thread appears without reload.

items.bug: AI itinerary generation takes about 60 s; the UI shows 'Failed to generate itinerary' although the server returned 200 with a plan
items.fix: Find the client-side timeout (desktop/src/lib/api) that aborts the request. Give AI generation calls a timeout above the server's own limit, show a progress state while it runs, and show the plan when it arrives. Do not change the AI model or prompt.
items.test: Unit test on the api client timeout for AI routes; no live AI request in tests.

items.bug: Ending a simulated inbound call from the call panel returns 500 '[mock] Call not found'
items.fix: The mock provider must find calls created by the call simulator (same store / same id). Real providers unchanged.
items.test: Backend test: simulate inbound, answer, hang up through the call-panel route: 200 and call status completed.

items.bug: The app requests /voip/token on every page and gets 403 where calling is off
items.fix: Only request the softphone token when calling is enabled for the agency (the feature/settings the app already knows).
items.test: Desktop unit or e2e: no /voip/token request on an agency where calling is off.

items.bug: Call detail with no transcript yet: GET transcript returns 404 and the page logs an error
items.fix: Return an empty/pending state (200 with null, or the UI treats 404 as 'no transcript yet' without an error).
items.test: Covered by an existing or new calls test.

items.bug: Mock checkout URL is built without the API port, so the tab cannot load (mock billing only)
items.fix: Build the mock checkout URL from the API's own base URL.
items.test: Backend test on the returned URL.

items.bug: A zero amount (for example '£0', 'AED 0', '€0') on the dashboard is shown in red like an error
items.fix: Zero is neutral, only negative or overdue values are red.
items.test: Desktop unit test on the formatting/colour helper if one exists.

outOfScope: Landing footer 'LEGAL (DRAFTS)' stays until the owner's legal pages are final
gates: targeted e2e for inbox, calls, reports on a local stack (single slot)
